text: An MPI is made like an MPC but with much more diafiltration: the more water that washes through the membrane, the more of the lactose and minerals leave and the closer the protein comes to 90 %. Microfiltered variants exist whose casein:whey ratio is shifted (82:18 to 95:5), but those are not the standard MPI.
